name: pastree-vscode
description: Development client for the PasTree LSP server

pastree.projectFile.description: The .dproj or .dpr the analysis closure starts from

pastree.logFile.description: Server log file path (empty = no file logging)

pastree.logUnits.description: Log one line per unit in the analysis closure (which file won for each unit name). Verbose - hundreds of lines per rebuild - so it is off unless you are chasing a search-path problem.

pastree.logDetail.description: Log the configuration inventory - every search path, define, namespace and unit alias handed to the analysis. Off keeps the one-line summary with the counts.

pastree.moduleRedoLimit.description: Incremental analysis: how many units an interface edit may pull in before the server rebuilds the closure instead. 0 = PasTree's measured default (128); a negative value lifts the ceiling entirely.

pastree.searchPaths.description: Extra unit search paths, appended after the project's

pastree.defines.description: Extra conditional defines, appended after the project's
